results.name: Parcels_FeatSvc
results.title: Parcels_FeatSvc
results.description:
MAPX / Feature Service for Parcel Features for the City of Council Bluffs, Iowa.    

Purpose: To allow specified users in the City of Council Bluffs to view and query features / records related to the Pottawattamie County Parcel featureclasses & geodatabase tables.

Featureclasses included: PARCELS_CB.    

Geodatabase tables included: N/A.   

There are no editable features included in this MXD / Map Service.   

ArcGIS Pro Project (APRX) that contain this MAPX: AGOL_CityOwnedProperty.   

Web Maps that include this feature service: SurplusProperty_WebMap.   

Web Apps that include this feature service: CB_SurplusProperty.  

For more information regarding this MAPX / Map Service, contact the City of Council Bluffs GIS Administrator.   

Name: Benjamin Lozano.    
Email: blozano@councilbluffs-ia.gov / gisadmin@councilbluffs-ia.gov.    
Phone: 712-890-5331.    
Office: 1 Ezra Jackson Way, Council Bluffs, IA 51503.
results.snippet: MAPX / Feature Service for Parcel Features for the City of Council Bluffs, Iowa.
results.accessInformation: City of Council Bluffs GIS Department, Pottawattamie County GIS Department
results.licenseInfo: Access to and usage of this feature service is restricted to City of Council Bluffs employees. This MAPX / Feature Service is not intended for use outside of the City of Council Bluffs intranet of the City of Council Bluffs AGOL Account. Access to this feature service is determined by the GIS Administrator. Approved user groups are maintained by Windows Active Directory & ArcGIS Portal's internal security credentials.
